jobs_results.title: BACKEND DEVELOPER (Laravel)
jobs_results.description:
Acierto.com, which is part of the Bauer Media Group, is the main insurance/financial comparator in Spain. Our mission is to help people save time and money in their household financial decisions. With more than 14 years of experience in the sector, our team is made up of more than 250 people. We provide information on the best insurance and banking products to more than 40,000 daily users.

We lead innovation in our sector thanks to the technology developed by our professionals. We are on a journey to grow and you have the chance to play a key role in it. Would you like to join us?

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

A PHP Ninja - Backend Developer who has a huge experience as +5 years.

A decisive person with the ability to integrate into innovation-oriented teams to face the new challenges that the market and customers throw at us.

Going into more detail, we need someone who has the following technical and personal skills to make the project grow.

We require:
• Solid hands-on with... developing web applications
• Strong aptitudes in OOP/SOLID/DRY principles
• Strong knowledge of PHP (Yii / Laravel is a Plus) and SQL (MySQL)
• Knowledge of TDD / DDD / BDD practices
• Knowledge of Relational & Non-Relational Databases / Document Databases.
• Familiar with LAMP environments, CI/CD practices, Git versioning system.
• Strong communication skills
• Good command of English

Nice to haves:
• Experience in Agile/SAFe methodologies
• Experience with Redis / NoSQL (MongoDB)
• Experience in ES6/Typescript / NodeJS / GraphQL
• Familiar with Headless architecture
• Knowledge of AWS services

WHAT WILL YOU DO?

You would support the development team in the migration of current applications to new business models/architecture.

You would be part of a constantly growing development team that handles internal and client development projects.

With your developments you would help our clients save money by applying to the best products for their personal finances (insurances, loans, mortgages,...).

WHAT WE OFFER?
• Permanent contract.
• Social benefits (medical insurance, transportation and ticket restaurants under flexible remuneration).
• Competitive salary according to value of the best candidate.
• Flexible hours and possibility of remote work.
• Friday afternoons off and summer schedule in August.
• Excellent work environment and professional project.
• Be part of an international group (Bauer Media Group OCP) where you can get and share knowledge and experiences.

LANGUAGES:
• You are fluent in Spanish and English.

LOCATION:
• Madrid o Barcelona

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
Headquartered in the vibrant city of Barcelona since 2013, Immfly strives to revolutionize the airline industry through cutting-edge digital solutions.

With a strategic global presence and offices spanning across Europe, Asia, and North & South America, our scalable and customizable offerings encompass In-Flight Entertainment, Connectivity, and Onboard Retail. We reach millions of passengers across hundreds of destinations, Making Every Flight One to Remember.

Join our dynamic team and become part of a community committed to innovation, excellence, and enhancing the passenger experience.

The Role

We are looking for a talented Backend Developer ready to fly with us!

As a Python Developer at Immfly, you will be participating in the development of multiple services that allow users to interact with our In-flight entertainment platform uniquely. Among these services, there are entertainment platforms, e-commerce solutions, integration with 3rd party APIs, handling data, and creating... reports.

What your day-to-day will look like
• Work with the backend team and other teams to build high-quality client experiences
• Become familiar with the existing Immfly technology stack
• Contribute to architectural, design, and process discussions involving the technological choices involved in building Immfly’s browser-based clients
• You'll identify and uphold backend engineering best practices
• Create, build, maintain, and optimize the backend project, and help create a microservices infrastructure.
• Work with a wide spectrum of partners including design & product infrastructure to define best practices and optimal solutions

What you should bring

Technical
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (M.S or PhD)
• 2+ years of experience working on large-scale Python applications
• 3+ years of software development experience.
• Open Source user: You have basic knowledge of scripting on Linux systems
• Experience with CI/CD, Go, Rust, or any other backend languages
• You've made new architectures work

Personal
• You are a proactive, persistent, and results-driven person
• You are a continuous learner, with a huge curiosity
• You are organized with high standards of quality and precision in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, environment
• A team player with a positive attitude & energy
• Trustworthy and excellent work ethics

Why join Immfly?
• A full-time permanent contract with an attractive compensation package according to your profile
• Flexible Compensation Plan (restaurant, transport, health insurance, and childcare)
• Flexible working hours with a hybrid-remote work policy (intensive workdays all Fridays and in August)
• An international environment (20 nationalities) with a dynamic and disruptive team
• Limitless professional development at Europe's fastest-growing company in its category

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
A Little Bit About Flanks

Flanks is a Barcelona-based fintech company focused on wealth management services. Its main product is a SaaS solution that helps financial advisors, family offices and other institutions to have a holistic view of their clients’ financial assets while using the latest scraping technology. We’re currently building the benchmark in the OpenWealth industry, and so far we managed to have compatibility with over 250 national and international entities.

Thanks to our clients, we continue to grow at a fast pace. We have already more than 300,000 aggregated portfolios spread across nearly 250 entities and have positioned our business at break-even in less than a year. In August 2021, Flanks raised €2.3 million in an investment round led by JME Ventures and SeedRocket 4Founders Capital. And a significant €7.5 million in August 2023, demonstrating confidence in our vision and capabilities.

We are pioneers in our market in Spain, which will certainly grow a lot in... the next few months and years. However, we are going to take a league leap in terms of the volumetry of the system, as our key focus now is to accelerate our market expansion in Europe and LatAm. And we would like to count on you to also grow (personally and professionally) with us.

Flanks’s values are:
• People first: To us, the most important thing is for “Flankers” to feel at ease, for them to get involved in a project and be feel part of the team.
• Keep growing: Our team believes that people growing in lockstep with the company is essential, both personally and professionally.
• Think twice, act once: We like to think about all the possible consequences before taking any decision that could affect the team or our clients.

If you’re looking to grow professionally in a very fast-growing company with an exciting start-up culture, this is your opportunity!

About The Role

You will be in charge of improving the scrapping system stability and availability. You'll be working as a full member of the Drivers Team, participating in the design, planning and execution of new features and the maintenance of the current ones. Furthermore, you will have an important role in the team, helping your colleagues to improve their skills.

Examples of tasks you can expect to work on are:
• Reverse engineering financial institutions websites, including login with two-factor authentication around the world
• Maintain and improve existing financial institution data scraping and infrastructure code.
• Extend Flanks financial institutions and country coverage.
• Design and implement internal tools to improve team workflow.
• Code review of your team colleagues

Things we'd love to see on you
• You are a nice person. Assholes and bigotry will not be tolerated.
• You have already a few years of experience in similar roles. We're looking for someone with some lessons already learned. Bonus points for professional experience in large Python codebases.
• Speaking Spanish at an advanced/native level is a must.
• You are a team player and a good communicator. You focus on communication over resolution.
• In general, the more experience with parts of our stack, the better. However, we're looking for the fundamentals, so don't worry if you don't check all the boxes.
• If you have experience in Fintech, SaaS products and message broker systems will be a plus.
• Willingness to solve challenging problems around financial data extraction.
• Willingness to mentor junior people

Our tech stack
• Python on our back-end, migrating to async-based for most parts.
• Vue in our front-end.
• Running on GKE
• Powered by MongoDB and PostgreSQL
• Also, Redis, RabbitMQ, Jenkins and other usual suspects.

What Can We Offer

This is a full-time, permanent contract.

A non-exhaustive list of perks includes:

🏠 Office between Sants Estació and Plaça Espanya, with a 280 degree view of Barcelona.

🔆 Flexible working hours

🎊 Paid time off on your birthday

🍒 Fresh fruit every week, all-you-can-drink tea and coffee

🍻 Friday happy hours after our weekly team meetings (optional)

😎 Team building events (optional)

🙀 Personal holidays swap inside the same month

🍽️ Digital canteen with Nora in our offices subsidized at 50%.

🏥 Health insurance

💸 Flexible remuneration with Cobee

📚 Yearly training budget

The hiring process

This is how the usual hiring process looks like:
• You send us your resume, cover letter, etc.
• A chat with our CTO, where we’ll dive deeper into your background, your possible fit, and where you’ll have the opportunity to ask any sort of questions.
• We will send you a few questions and give you some time to think about them. Then, we’ll schedule a chat to go through them and discuss possibilities, approaches and tradeoffs.
• A meeting with our CEO.
• Optionally, any other meeting you, or we might need to clarify any pending questions.
• We send you an offer.

If you think you meet most of the criteria described above, don’t hesitate to send us your CV and/or cover letter. We will be happy to hear from you!

Flanks is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion both in our hiring practices and in our experiences as a Flanks employee. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage all applicants regardless of race, religion, or belief (if any), nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status

¿Quieres formar parte de la misión de democratizar el acceso a las altas rentabilidades del mercado inmobiliario de startups y renovables?

¡Somos wecity! El ecosistema tecnológico e innovador donde promotores e inversores se comunican financian y comparten beneficios de manera sostenible.

¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS?

Un programador/a back al que le apasiona la programación y le motivan los nuevos retos.

Te unirás a un equipo de IT formado por perfiles backend y frontend.

Ayudarás al crecimiento y la escalabilidad de proyectos en curso y formarás parte de la arquitectura y definición de proyectos nuevos.
• Abordar y resolver desafíos técnicos con soluciones innovadoras.
• Participar activamente en decisiones técnicas y estratégicas.
• Desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades
• Optimización y refactorización.
• Resolución de incidencias

REQUISITOS

Imprescindibles

+3 años de experiencia de programación en PHP

Nivel avanzado de SQL

Experiencia con proyectos legacy y definición de arquitecturas en... nuevos desarrollos

Capacidad analítica y lógica para seguir la traza de los diferentes procesos

Actitud proactiva y buena capacidad organizativa.

Que te guste y sepas trabajar en equipo.

Buen humor y ganas de aprender y enseñar

Deseables

Conocimientos de OOP SOLID patrones de diseño

Acostumbrado a trabajar con control de versiones

Desarrollo integración y consumo de APIs

Conocimientos básicos de HTML CSS JavaScript

Wordpress
• Y ya sería la bomba

Experiencia o alto interés en TDD DDD (Domain Driven Design) arquitecturas limpias.

Testing

Desarrollo fullstack (Angular)

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?

Incorporarte a una empresa consolidada solvente y en pleno crecimiento donde valoramos al máximo el buen ambiente tanto en nuestro equipo como en la relación con nuestros clientes.

Y además

Puesto de trabajo estable. Contrato indefinido.

Oficina en Paseo de la Castellana junto a plaza de Colón

Flexibilidad horaria

Posibilidad de Teletrabajo

Sueldo a convenir en función de experiencia y aptitudes.

Revisión salarial todos los años.

EL PROCESO

Proceso ágil de selección dividido en varias fases
• Evaluación de solicitudes
• Entrevista Tech / Prueba Tech
• Oferta

APÚNTATE

¿Quieres saber más? ¡Apúntate!

Estaremos encantados de conocerte!

PHP, Angular

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de back -end
jobs_results.description:
Saiyan Workout es una app de entrenamiento que busca ayudar a las personas en su camino hacia una vida saludable basando todas sus aportaciones en la evidencia científica sobre deporte y nutrición. ¿Quieres trabajar con nosotros para llevar a Saiyan Workout al siguiente nivel? ¿Te gustaría trabajar en un entorno en el que participar y trabajar de forma innovadora? ¡En la familia de SW estaremos encantados de recibirte con los brazos abiertos!

La figura de desarrollador es central en Saiyan Workout. Lo que empezó como un pequeño proyecto ha escalado hasta límites insospechados, y necesitamos que el equipo crezca para mantenernos en constante actualización y mejora. ¿Aceptas el reto?

Tareas
• Desempeñarás las funciones de mantenimiento de la app.
• Gestionarás las actualizaciones para la corrección de bugs.
• Trabajarás codo con codo con el equipo para incluir las mejoras que Saiyan Workout necesite.

Requisitos

Ingeniero informático o similar, con experiencia en desarrollo web y... móvil, con conocimientos en las siguientes tecnologías:
• Angular en su versión 16, que trabaje con Angular Material, Angular Universal y NGRx
• Ionic en su versión 7 para desarrollo móvil híbrido (Android & iOS), que tenga experiencia en despliegue de apps en tiendas como Google Play y Appstore.
• NodeJS para la creación de APIs con ExpressJS, autenticación con JWT, uso del ORM Sequelize, Sockets, envío de correos con NodeMailer, manejo de plantillas EJS e integración con AWS.
• PostgreSQL como motor de base de datos.
• AWS: Manejo de instancias de EC2 de Ubuntu, buckets de S3, balanceadores de carga, CloudFront, Route 53, RDS.
• Despliegues en Linux, específicamente Ubuntu.
• GIT: para manejo de versiones de código.

Beneficios

Un gran poder conlleva una gran responsabilidad, pero te ofreceremos nuestra ayuda en todo momento del proceso, facilitándote las últimas formaciones en marketing digital y trabajando mano a mano contigo para que puedas empaparte del espíritu de Saiyan Workout. No hace falta que lo hagas todo perfecto, ¡solo que quieras hacerlo perfecto!

¿Te apuntas? ¡Estamos deseando saber de ti

jobs_results.title: Back-end Developer
jobs_results.description:
Insight

If you want to join in a diverse team, where everyone has a voice and works as part of a team. Moreover, you have experience as a Back-end Developer, with a passion for solving business problems through innovation and engineering practice, then you are in the right place!

How will you make an impact?
• Participate hands-on Java planning, development, deployment, adoption of modern software engineering & delivery practices using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices.
• Analyze business and functional requirements and translate technical requirements into programmed application modules.
• Build software and tools that increase the development velocity of every engineer without sacrificing quality.
• Tackle interesting and challenging problem on large scale datasets, high performance, availability, and reliability requirements.
• Partner closely with cross-functional teams including product management design, performance marketing, analytics, and others throughout the business... to give input into the end-to-end customer experience.

What Will you need to success?
• 3+ years of advanced knowledge of architecture, microservices, and designing of enterprise applications.
• 2+ years’ experience and strong expertise in object-oriented languages and design principles and methodologies. Experience with Java and the Spring framework is preferred. Development experience with any of the following are a strong plus: Python, C++, C#, JavaScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins, REST, Scala.
• Demonstrate a passion for learning and a willingness to adopt new technologies.
• Contribute to a culture of innovation, ideas, and continuous improvement, along with a great attitude, solid communication skills, willingness to learn and collaborate
• Good understanding of Agile development methodology and techniques.
• Fluent in English.

Why would you work with us?

We are committed to keep a healthy environment for our employees, where they will feel motivated, creative, and focused.

Benefits

We've designed our benefits and staffing programs keeping on mind all those features. Therefore, we are an organization it has been worried to create a great place to work, where you might be part of us. Here, you can find some of our benefits:
• Flexible Work Schedule.
• Mentoring & Coaching.
• Team based strategic planning.
• Remote Work Program.
• Multicultural environment.
• Flexible Compensation.
• Home Office Staff.

About Us

At Excibit Solutions Spain we are experts in technology and believe in its power to support our clients to reach their accomplishment, fostering excellence and increasing positive impact policy within the consultancy market. All based in our cornerstones: commitment, excellence, ethics and honesty

jobs_results.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Sportserve forms part of a remarkable group of B2C sports betting and B2B sportsbook technology companies, focused on delivering first class sports betting experiences and casino products for our users worldwide. Along with Sportion, TechSpirit, Standard Focus and Sportelligent, we are the driving force behind the world renowned sports betting company and our flagship brand, Dafabet.

Since launching our global hiring initiative, we now employ over 2,000 people worldwide, offering exciting career paths in Technology, Trading, Operations and Media. We pride ourselves on having a diverse and international culture that embraces the global community and acts locally. We offer office based, hybrid and remote work on permanent and consultancy contracts all over the world, making us the true global employer of choice.

We are looking for a talented Senior Backend Developer who is looking to make the transition from coding as a full time role, into a technical leadership position. You will be... responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the backend systems and infrastructure of our BI & AI as well as our Machine Learning software applications and systems.

The Senior Backend Developer is a key member of the Sports team and will contribute to the overall success of the company by building robust and efficient backend solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality and scalable software products and drive innovation in our technology stack.

What you'll be getting up to:
• Working across a number of business areas providing development, maintenance and support.
• Working as part of a team and occasionally working solo on development pieces of work as the business needs arise.
• Take ownership for the overall planning, execution and success of complex technical projects.
• Collaborate with other engineers and leaders across the company and ensure all our tools have the expected impact.
• Design and implement tools that help engineering teams focus on shipping features, while making sure we're building infrastructure that is cost efficient, secure and reliable.
• Help identify probable causes and provide immediate solution during an incident
• Drive forward the Agile mindset what of delivering - with the focus on speed to market.
• Contribute significant ideas for making the applications user friendly.
• Participate in cutting edge research in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications.
• Contribute to engineering efforts from planning and organisation to execution and delivery to solve complex, real-world engineering problems.
• Develop and organise cloud systems.
• Work closely with IT security to monitor the company's cloud privacy.
• Respond to technical issues in a professional and timely manner.
• Take responsibility for the overall planning, execution and success of complex projects.
• Proactively communicate with leadership: provide context around risks/blockers/timeline, seek guidance, and recommend a direction.

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or any related technical field.
• 5+ years of relevant work experience
• Excellent command of the English language - Written & Spoken.
• Expert knowledge of Java, Golang, Rust (At Least two) and open source software (e.g. Spring).
• Advanced knowledge of SQL, preferably with Oracle databases and Postgresql
• Experience working with API’s microservices and data manipulation.
• Distributed caching (Hazelcast or Redis).
• Knowledge of Asynchronous Messaging (Pubsub, Kafka, RabbitMQ or JMS).
• Experience developing back office trading tools using GWT/Vaadin, SWT, Swing or JavaFX.
• Demonstrable knowledge of Maven and Linux.
• Experience building highly transactional, high volume distributed applications.
• Knowledge of JVM monitoring and performance tuning Java applications, as well as troubleshooting issues in production
• The team is a full stack team and the core skills are Java, Go (Golang), Python, C# and Typescript or Javascript.
• Experience with Cloud IaaS and DevOps Platforms like Terraform, Automation, or equivalent technology.
• Hands-on Experience with GCP Foundation, Storage bucket, Backup, Disaster Recovery, VPC networks, IAM, Stack driver, Troubleshooting, and Cloud Security.
• Applications in English please

Diversity & Inclusion

We embrace diversity and equality in a serious way. We are committed to building a team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of Equality isn’t just the right thing to do, it’s also the smart thing

jobs_results.title: Back End Developer
jobs_results.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Exciting opportunity for a Senior Backend Engineer with experience in supporting multiple teams to join a mobile games studio based in Barcelona working on innovative and ambitious mobile games! Great opportunity to join a young studio to be a core part of the studio's future successes'

This hybrid position necessitates a minimum of 4 years' industry experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Utilize your extensive expertise in game backend systems to support multiple development teams in creating engaging game elements.
• Create game infrastructures using platforms like PlayFab, AWS, or Azure, ensuring smooth integration and optimal performance.
• Design various gameplay elements such as leaderboards, live events, season passes, level progression, crafting, shops, and in-app purchases.
• Ability to write efficient and maintainable code
• Devise and implement new services according to stakeholder priorities.

REQUIREMENTS:
• 4+ years of games industry experience, with... proficiency in mobile development and frameworks such as Playfab.
• Genuine passion for making and playing mobile games
• Strong problem-solving skills and commitment to collaboration.
• Experience in SignalR, AWS, Azure functions, Redis, Jenkins, DataDog, Kibana, GitHub actions

Desired Skills:
• A keen interest in Mobile Games
• Multiplayer game development experience, including dedicated servers, replication, and client prediction.

How to Apply:

If you are a Senior Backend Engineer looking to be pat of an ambitious team, please submit your resume to fiona@eleven-eleven.io or contact me at 07305 324791

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Wincom is a software development company working in the field of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM). We extend one of the most used PLM software to adjust it to our customer s needs. We work directly for the major manufacturing companies in the world from luxury goods to aerospace and several of our customers are in the Fortune 500. For the past 10 years we have extended our footprint to over 120 customers in 16 countries.

What makes us unique? We think out-of-the-box We have created a unique and innovative architecture that allow us to build deploy and support software in a lean agile and secure way that is making us a reference in our sector.

If you are looking to grow your technical skills and learn coding best practices based on the latest techniques and concepts come work with us! We offer an excellent learning environment where you will be fully trained to gain differentiating expertise. You will also improve your soft skills by working with a cross-functional team (QA Support... Sales) and interacting directly with customers.

The position

We are looking for a full-time Backend Developer with or without experience. The salary is between 25 000 30 000 .

Responsabilities

Participate in the whole lifecycle of applications from development to maintenance.

Enhance existing software portfolio.

Interact with other developers to integrate developed software.

Interact with the end customer and/or the main contractors.

Issue resolution you will support customers that report issues on their products in coordination with the QA and Support team.

Testing and optimization

Support presales activities

Report to the project manager and/or the technical leads

MUST HAVE TECHNICAL BACKGROUND

Good knowledge of Linux and Windows

Java and Object-Oriented development

JavaScript

Understanding of Source Control Management (Subversion Git)

Maven

IDE (NetBeans and or Eclipse)

NICE TO HAVE TECHNICAL BACKGROUND

Knowledge of database (Oracle MS SQL).

Java standards and libraries (JAXB Spring Thymleaf...)

Knowledge of W3C standards (XML XSD HTML etc....)

Javascript Libraries/Frameworks such as JQuery REACT Angular....

Knowledge Libraries/Frameworks IT administration is a plus.

Your Skills

Fluent English both spoken and written as it is the language used in the company is a must-have.

High analytical capacity and motivation for technically challenging problems

Good communication clear and concise reporting

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Continuous training

Private medical and dental insurance

Offices in the very center of Barcelona

Spanish / English classes with experienced teacher

Bonus program

Linux, Java, JavaScript, Maven, NetBeans, Eclipse , Oracle, SQL, JAXB, Spring, W3C, XML, XSD, HTML, Javascript
